```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
R.version.string
BiocManager::install("microbiome")
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggpubr)
library(microbiome)
library(indicspecies)

library(indicspecies)

## Load the data-- filtering for just patients with PD 

```{r load_data}

#filter for just PD patients 

metadata_unfiltered = read.delim('parkinsons_metadata.txt', row.names = 1) 

metadata <- metadata_unfiltered %>%
  filter(Disease == "PD")

taxonomy = read.delim('taxonomy.tsv', row.names = 1)

counts = read.delim('feature-table.txt', skip=1, row.names=1)  

```

#  Make a Phyloseq object


```{r}


# Wrangle Tables


taxonomy_formatted = taxonomy %>%
  separate(col = Taxon,
           into = c('Domain', 'Phylum', 'Class', 'Order', 'Family', 'Genus', 'Species'),
           sep=';', fill = 'right') %>%
  select(-Confidence) %>%
  as.matrix()

counts_formatted = counts %>% as.matrix()

#Extract Column Names
meta_names = read.delim ('parkinsons_metadata.txt', row.names = 1) %>% names ()

#Extract Data
meta_data = read.delim ('parkinsons_metadata.txt', row.names = 1, skip = 1, header = F)

# Just checking to make sure the lines match up from the original data
table(metadata [1,] == metadata [1,])

# all 85 were true!

#now setting column names for metadata
names (meta_data) = meta_names

#Finally putting it all together to create the phyloseq object
ps = phyloseq(sample_data(metadata),
              otu_table(counts_formatted, taxa_are_rows = T),
              tax_table(taxonomy_formatted))
# Lastly I am saving it so that I can refer to it later
saveRDS(ps, 'phyloseq_taxonomy.rds')
```


## Calculating Shannon Alpha Diversity 

```{r part 2}


hist(sample_sums(ps))

#using a sampling depth of 5103 as seen in literature

psrare = ps %>% rarefy_even_depth(sample.size = 5103, rngseed = 123)
# showing that all samples have a sampling depth of 5500
table(sample_sums(psrare))

# Calculate the Shannon alpha diversity using the variable Lived_on_farm
set.seed(123)
shannon = plot_richness(psrare, x = 'Lived_on_farm', measures = c('Shannon'))

p = plot_richness(psrare, x = 'Lived_on_farm', 
                  measures = c('Shannon'),
                  color = 'Lived_on_farm',
                  )
p 



# pulling the Shannon alpha diversity values from the plot 
pdata = p$data

# Generating an appropriate publication-ready plot

p_formatted = pdata %>% ggplot(aes(Lived_on_farm,value,fill = Lived_on_farm)) +
 geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
    geom_jitter(height=0,width=.25) +
    theme_classic(base_size=6) +
  facet_wrap(~variable,ncol=4,scales = 'free_y') +
  ylab('Shannon Alpha Diversity') + xlab('Lived on Farm') +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,vjust=1,hjust=1,size = 14), 
  axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.title   = element_text(size = 16),
  strip.text   = element_text(size = 16),  
  legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = 12)
) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"))
  labs(fill='Lived on Farm') 
  p_formatted

# Adding a Wilcoxon test 

comparisons <- list(c("Yes", "No"))

p_final <- p_formatted +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons, method = "wilcox.test", size = 6) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .1)))


p_final 
ggsave(
  "Shannon_farm_comparison.png",
  plot = p_final,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
